name: The Darkmoon Faire
text: A caravan of striped tents and creaking wagons rolls into view: Silas Darkmoon's Faire has come to our lands! Games of chance, strange beasts, a fortune-teller named Sayge and a great many tickets for sale.

choices.text: Host the Faire in our capital (-100 Gold, a short Golden Age)
Try our luck at the games (-40 Gold, win up to 120)
Ask Sayge to read our fortune (+Science)

name: Plague of Undeath
text: Grain from the north has been tainted. Those who ate the bread sicken, die... and rise again. The Cult of the Damned is spreading the plague of undeath through our granaries, as it once did in Lordaeron.

choices.text: Ward the granaries with arcane seals (-25 Mana)
Burn the infected granaries (-120 Gold)
Call on the priests to cleanse the grain (-80 Faith)
Seal the gates and hope (lose population)

name: Legion Incursion
text: The sky tears open in a wound of green fire. A fel rift has opened near our lands, and the demons of the Burning Legion are pouring through!

choices.text: Stand and fight! (demons attack; heroes rise to meet them)

choices.text: Close the rift with a great spell (-35 Mana)
Seal the rift with arcane might (-200 Gold)

name: A Goblin Offer
text: A Steamwheedle Cartel zeppelin touches down outside the capital. A goblin in a fine suit steps out: "Time is money, friend! Have I got a deal for you..."

choices.text: Buy the goblin blueprints (-100 Gold, +Science)
Sell them our surplus grain (+Gold, lose population)
Send them packing

name: The Lunar Festival
text: The Lunar Festival has come, and the spirits of the elders walk among us. Lanterns float over the rooftops and the people ask how we will honor the old ones.

choices.text: Pay homage to the elders (+Faith)
Launch fireworks over the capital (-30 Gold, +Culture)

name: Brewfest
text: Dwarven brewers have rolled their kegs into town for Brewfest. The people are already singing, and the Dark Iron dwarves are sure to crash the party.

choices.text: Sponsor the festival (-80 Gold, a short Golden Age)
Tax the kegs (+Gold)

name: Children's Week
text: War has left many orphans in our lands. The matrons of the orphanage ask our citizens to take them in.

choices.text: Take in the orphans (-30 Gold, +1 population)
Fund the orphanage (+Culture)

name: Gnomish Refugees
text: Gnomes driven from irradiated Gnomeregan arrive at our gates with nothing but their tools and a great deal of enthusiasm.

choices.text: Welcome them into our cities (-40 Gold, +2 population)
Put them to work in our workshops (+Science)

name: A Titan Vault

choices.text: Tap the vault's power (+40 Mana)
Study the Titan relics (+Science)
Sell the relics to collectors (+Gold)

Seek the blessing of the Dragon Aspects (-100 Faith)
